name: Kisnyárád (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kisnyárád (a blue shield with a yellow ploughshare, a bunch of grapes and a star, with yellow and blue mantling) below the name KISNYÁRÁD in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
